title: SessionPatch
description: Editable fields of a Session. All optional; at least one required. `model` and `workspace` are nullable — sending null clears the field to inherit/none (model ⇒ inherit per Personas §5 precedence; workspace ⇒ no rooted workspace). Identity/derived fields (id, persona_id, members, kind, version, token_count, timestamps) are NOT patchable here; member lifecycle is a separate, scoped concern (member add/remove ops).

workspace.description: Opaque host-defined execution locator; null ⇒ clear to no rooted workspace (Foundation §4.4).
